hero.title: Your business deserves to be
hero.subtitle: A site people find on Google, and someone who answers you once it is live. Cosmic Studio builds websites and apps for craftspeople, small businesses, independents and associations.

audience.title: For people who already have a trade and no time to learn another.

artisans.title: Craftspeople
artisans.description: Carpenter, plumber, hairdresser, caterer… A site that says what you do, where you work and how to reach you, and that people find when they search for your trade nearby.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: Choir, sports club, collective… Your events, memberships and news in one place, to spread the word about your activities and welcome new members.

independents.title: Independents and professional practices
independents.description: Lawyer, architect, osteopath, consultant… Someone recommends you, then people look at your site before they call. It presents your practice and your background, and says how to book an appointment.

companies.title: Small businesses
companies.description: Building firm, engineering consultancy, garage, an agency of a few people… Your site shows what you can do, both to future clients and to people you would like to hire.

why.title: Wix and WordPress are handy at first.
why.lead: Then you need a paid plugin, an update breaks a page, the subscription goes up. We write the code ourselves, so your site stays fast and can grow without starting over.

person.title: Someone who answers
person.description: You talk to Matthieu, who knows your site because he built it.

fast.title: Fast on a phone
fast.description: Without a heavy theme or plugins, your pages load quickly on a phone, and Google takes that into account in its results.

grows.title: Add more without starting over
grows.description: You start with one page. The day you need appointment booking, an English version or a shop, we add it to the existing site.

ownership.title: You own it
ownership.description: Your texts, your photos and your domain name belong to you from day one. The code is transferred to you after {months} months of subscription: that is what makes such a low starting price possible. Before then, it is transferred to you for a transfer fee.

process.title: Four steps, and a date set at the start.
process.subtitle: From the first conversation to launch day, you know where your project stands.

discovery.label: T-3 · Meeting
discovery.title: We get to know each other
discovery.description: Twenty minutes on the phone or over a coffee in Geneva or Annecy, to talk about your trade, your customers and what the site should do for you.

design.label: T-2 · Mockup
design.title: You see it before you decide
design.description: We prepare a mockup of your home page. If you already have a site, it reuses its colours and texts; otherwise, it starts from the palette and the guidance you gave us. It is free, you are under no obligation, and you can ask for it without booking a meeting.

build.label: T-1 · Build
build.title: We build the site
build.description: Allow two to six weeks depending on the project. You follow progress on a private link and send us your feedback along the way.

launch.label: T-0 · Launch
launch.title: We stay after launch
launch.description: We put the site online and show you how it works. After that, we take care of hosting and backups, with one change a year included, and more as an option if you need it. Coach'n Pulse's site, for example, has been looked after since 2016.

pricing.title: A subscription, or a custom project.
pricing.all: See the four ways to work with us

apps.title: We also build our own app.
apps.lead: We use it to try out our tools before using them on your site.

daily_fortune.name: Daily Fortune
daily_fortune.description: A short message every morning to start the day on the right foot. It is our first app, available on the App Store.

studio.title: Behind Cosmic Studio, there is Matthieu.
paragraphs: Matthieu Compérat comes from Duingt, on the shores of Lake Annecy, and now lives in Chêne-Bougeries. He has been building websites and apps for about fifteen years, first for large companies. With Cosmic Studio, he does the same job for smaller businesses, and works directly with the person who runs them.
When you call, he is the one who picks up, and your messages usually get a reply the same day. He knows the site he delivers inside out, which keeps every change quick and simple.

cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines. We reply quickly to talk it through, before suggesting anything.
cta.freeMockup: If you would rather see something before we talk, ask for a <link>free mockup</link>.
cta.title: Let's make your business shine.
